hero.lede: Deterministic fixtures for merge conflicts, submodules, multiple remotes, in‑progress operations, monorepos, and more — plus in‑memory mock factories for blazing‑fast unit tests. Real repos or typed mocks, one line each.
hero.schematicAriaLabel: Schematic showing how git-scenarios composes atoms into scenarios into the public API
hero.svgLegendLine1: Composition diagram — atoms compose into scenarios; the public
hero.svgLegendLine2: API and CLI consume the registry. Same shape every test run.

playground.emptyRepoText: This scenario has no commits — HEAD is unborn.
playground.emptyRepoHint: Useful for testing empty-state UI: branch views, log views, the "create your first commit" affordance, etc.
diagramConflicts.caption: Four mid-operation states — each leaves a distinct .git/ marker file. git-scenarios produces all four deterministically.
diagramConflicts.descMerge: Two branches edit the same line. Merge halts; conflict markers in worktree.
diagramConflicts.descRebase: Replay halts on a conflict. REBASE_HEAD set; resume with --continue.
diagramConflicts.descCherryPick: Pick from another branch conflicts. Worktree shows both sides.
diagramConflicts.descRevert: Reverting a commit conflicts with later changes. Distinct UI state.
diagramPipeline.caption: Two output modes: spinUpScenario for real repos on disk, mockFromScenario for typed in-memory mocks.
diagramPipeline.ariaLabel: Pipeline diagram showing two paths: spinUpScenario produces a real temp git repo, mockFromScenario produces typed in-memory mock objects
diagramPipeline.noDiskIoHint: no disk I/O · no simple-git runtime · <1ms
